{{Top|leg}}
A '''Solar Converter''' was a type of [[Fuel converter]]. They were huge, molecule-thick [[Star/Legends|solar]]-absorbent sails. They converted solar energy into fuel at a rate of around one to three fuel cells a day depending on the distance between the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and the star.
